Sunset times: early July ~18:42 and latest sunset ~4 July 18:43, earliest ~27 November 17:15 (seen in search result: sunrise-sunset.org/vn/hanoi); 15 Sept 17:59, 15 Oct 17:32, 15 Nov 17:15, 15 Dec 17:17 for 2026 (seen in search result: alpenglowapp.com/times/hanoi); 1 July 2026 sunrise/sunset 5:18/18:42 (seen in search result: sunrise-sunset.net). The 'arriver une heure avant' column is stated as advice, not data. Geography: West Lake lies west of the centre, so the east shore and the Thanh Niên dike look west; from the east bank of the Red River the view is west towards the city — reasoned from the map, not from a source. Weekend closure around Hoan Kiem (Vietnam Airlines, reused from hub); Long Bien bridge reopened 28 May 2026 (Viet Nam News, reused); festival-night parking surcharges (Lao Động, reused). Price: only owner range for automatic scooter with disclaimer. Shop: 09:00–21:00, same-evening return phrased as question, nothing confirmed. No deposit, delivery, insurance or assistance statement.

evidence.FACTS: Removed unsourced and mannered claims from the old text: 'à cinq minutes de tout', 'moins d’une heure détendue', 'sentier ombragé sur toute leur longueur', 'quelques établissements de rive disposent de terrasses sur les toits', 'ronds-points calmes … l’école de pilotage de la ville', 'les tarifs se paient en monnaie locale'. Now: legend of the returned sword and Thê Húc bridge/Ngọc Sơn temple/Turtle Tower (seen in search results: vietnamisawesome.com, asiaforvisitors.com, Vietnam Airlines 'what to visit in Hanoi'); temple ticket booth in front of Thê Húc bridge, hours differ by source (8:00–18:00 / 7:00–18:00 / 7:00–21:00 weekend), preserved turtles displayed (same results) — no price or hours quoted. Sunrise/sunset ranges (seen in search results: sunrise-sunset.net July 2026; alpenglowapp.com mid-December). Tràng Tiền–Opera five-minute walk from Đinh Tiên Hoàng (Fodor's, seen in search result). Weekend closure of Hoan Kiem streets and Old Quarter evening pedestrian streets 19:00–24:00 (Vietnam Airlines and Thời báo Tài chính Việt Nam, reused from hanoi/index.html); March 2026 suspension and reopening on Friday 20 March at 19:00 (Báo Văn hóa, reused); low-emission zone since 1 July 2026 with extension planned from 2027 (VietNamNet, reused); festival-night parking surcharges (Lao Động, reused); Long Bien bridge reopening (Viet Nam News, reused). The water-puppet theatre at the lake is mentioned from general knowledge without address/price. Price: only owner range for automatic scooter with disclaimer. Shop: 09:00–21:00 only. No deposit, delivery, insurance, assistance or fleet statement.
